mundiyar toll

resolutionDetails.summary:
Reason:
Reader misinterpretation of a single low-quality tag
Duplicate EPC generation with minor variation (last digit difference)
Resulting in multiple reads and data transmission

Assigned to self by Shivam Pandey

Issue fixed and ready for verification: Reason:
Reader misinterpretation of a single low-quality tag
Duplicate EPC generation with minor variation (last digit difference)
Resulting in multiple reads and data transmission

comments.text:
Details:
22-04-2026 11:09:14.017 – TagAddedToQueue
EPC: 34161FA820328EE841E434E0
Userdata: 585858585858585858585858040068A700DED6B3D93AB403BC48C5F3993C9FD516BBA205F40267DD7BAD2E64CFE90000
22-04-2026 11:09:14.559 – TagAddedToQueue
EPC: 34161FA820328EE841E434A0
Userdata: 58585858585858585858585804005E1EC0F80AB8B9563491BC9E7BEF8DFC234330B9F0C2E7E4F205C6F52D73861D0000

Reader misinterpretation of a single low-quality tag
Duplicate EPC generation with minor variation (last digit difference)
Resulting in multiple reads and data transmission
